title: Reusable Paper Towel Alternatives: Good Housekeeping Lab Picks
desc: Good Housekeeping Cleaning Lab tested reusable alternatives for spill cleaning and absorbency. Each pick has a different labeled use/category, not a composite rank.

source.name: Good Housekeeping Institute — Best Reusable Paper Towels (2026)
source.note: All listed products, source labels and selection context were checked against the linked source by AllRanks on 2026-10-21. The source presents distinct use-case awards, not a like-for-like composite score; the displayed order follows its numbered article sections.

items.name: RECYCO Swedish Dishcloths
items.detail: Best overall; compostable and highly absorbent.

items.name: Ecozoi Reusable Bamboo Paper Towels
items.detail: Best value; roll format and strong absorbency.

items.name: Maker's Clean Kitchen Cloth
items.detail: Best kitchen cloth; tied for top spill-cleaning score.

items.name: Fabuloso Microfiber Cloths
items.detail: Best microfiber; highest water absorption in this test.

items.name: Guests on Earth Waffle Cleaning Cloths
items.detail: Best premium; excelled at spill cleanup.
